name: binary-ng-native
description: binary_ng Quasar-native no-broadcast program: kernels_qsr reader_no_bcast_dfb / eltwise_binary_{,sfpu_}no_bcast_dfb / writer_no_bcast_dfb, built by binary_ng_quasar_native_factory.cpp.
stages: reader thread t of R: tiles {t, t+R, ...}; counter-major walk over num_tcs = C/R counters (C>=R) with dm_batch tiles from ONE counter per batch; per batch: reserve_back per moving input, one async_read per tile per moving input, one async_read_barrier, push_back per moving input. dm_batch==1 runs a cheaper plain loop.
ring: STRIDED DFB, max(P,C) tile counters, tile i -> counter i % max(P,C), capacity entries_per_thread per counter

compute thread c of C: tiles {c, c+C, ...} in chunks of tiles_per_cycle; unpack TRISC: wait_front x2, unpack, pop_front x2; math TRISC: binary op into a half-sync DST section; pack TRISC: reserve_back, pack, push_back
writer thread w of W: counter-major walk over num_tcs = C/W counters; per batch: wait_front, one async_write per tile, async_write_barrier, pop_front
borrowed operand: the ring IS the resident L1 shard/slice; reader publishes once per counter (R=1), writer pops once per counter (W=1)

routing.note: matches_quasar_native_slice (binary_ng_device_operation.cpp) admits ADD, SUB, MUL, DIV in bf16 or fp32, no broadcast; is_binary_sfpu_op (binary_ng_device_operation.cpp:26): MUL/DIV are SFPU unless fast_and_approximate_mode; ADD/SUB are SFPU only for fp32/int. fp32 runs only the SFPU kernel (fp32_dest_acc_en follows fp32 inputs); the gate refuses bf16 SFPU add/subtract and FPU divide. Other binary ops (rsub, maximum, minimum, logaddexp, ...) and every subtile broadcast run on the Metal 2.0 (DFB) factory, or fail to build on Quasar (qperf/rule.py NOT_NATIVE).

unsupported: broadcast (row/col/scalar/mixed) programs: the native gate refuses them; the Metal 2.0 (DFB) factory runs them with its own bcast readers and compute (kernels_dfb), checked on craq-sim
tail rings of a borrowed shard not divisible by C (cost reported as a warning only)
sharded operands moved over the NoC (factory keeps batch 1; model treats them as interleaved NoC reads)

knob_limits.source: binary_ng_utils.cpp native_tuning read_knob: kMaxThreads=8, kMaxBatch=8 (dm_batch AND tiles_per_cycle), kMaxEntriesPerThread=255
